definition: See Explainable AI — the broader property and set of techniques for making AI system behavior understandable to humans.
details: Explainability is closely related to but distinct from interpretability; explainability often emphasizes providing human-understandable justifications for outputs, while interpretability emphasizes understanding the model's internal mechanisms.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. In plain words: See Explainable AI — the broader property and set of techniques for making AI system behavior understandable to humans. Here is how it actually plays out: Explainability is closely related to but distinct from interpretability; explainability often emphasizes providing human-understandable justifications for outputs, while interpretability emphasizes understanding the model's internal mechanisms. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” That deliberate caution is Explainability.
